findings.title: Hardcoded 'or True' in supervisor_tools exception handler causes immediate graph termination on any error
findings.impact: Any transient exception or tool execution error during sub-research task execution immediately aborts the entire research phase and terminates the supervisor workflow.
findings.preconditions: An exception (e.g., tool error, network failure, or API exception) occurs during ConductResearch execution in supervisor_tools.
findings.explanation: In supervisor_tools, the exception handler for delegated research execution contains 'if is_token_limit_exceeded(e, configurable.research_model) or True:'. The 'or True' disjunction ensures that any exception evaluates to true, forcing the supervisor graph to return Command(goto=END). This prevents error recovery, retries, or returning error ToolMessages to the supervisor model.

findings.impact: Token limit exceeded exceptions raised by the compression model may not be recognized if the research model uses a different model provider.
findings.preconditions: configurable.compression_model and configurable.research_model belong to different model providers (e.g., Anthropic vs OpenAI), and compression_model raises a context/token limit exception.
findings.explanation: In compress_research, synthesizer_model is created using configurable.compression_model. However, when catching exceptions inside the retry loop, is_token_limit_exceeded(e, configurable.research_model) is invoked with configurable.research_model. Because is_token_limit_exceeded uses the model prefix to select provider-specific error checks, mismatched model identifiers cause token limit detection to fail.
